description:
Closes fz-kdt.34's acceptance contract on `enum_take_drop_split`,
`fz_f98_range_map_converges` and `enum_predicate_search`, using ONLY the public
log.

## The derivation -- causality is derived, not stored

The scheduler records WHICH facts a job read but never at what revision
(`DependencyIndex.reads: HashMap<J, HashSet<FactUse<F>>>`, `deps.rs:15`). The
product engine is the opposite (`ProductDependencies` stores `FactState` and
generations, `pull.rs:259`). So "did this formula's input move since its own
prior conclusion?" cannot be answered by asking the scheduler without adding the
second dependency ledger this ticket forbids.

It IS answerable by replaying the ordered stream. For evaluation e of formula F
at time t, the moved inputs are exactly

    (F's reads UNION F's blocked-set from its previous completion)
      for which a movement appears in the stream between F's previous
      conclusion and t

Reads alone are NOT enough: `reads` and `waits` are separate maps (`deps.rs:15-19`)
and a job re-run because a WAIT became satisfiable (`scheduler.rs:413`) has that
fact in `waits`. Using reads alone false-flags it as uncaused.

## Cross-run equality needs fz-f98.21

"Repeated runs produce identical causal work multisets" cannot be checked on raw
`Ty` ids: they are measured run-unstable (4 processes, 16 differing arena slots;
see fz-kdt.47, fz-kdt.48). And it must NOT be checked through `Types::display`,
which is measured non-injective -- `Ty(83)` and `Ty(253)` both render
`([int]) -> r0` while `253 <: 83`, so two different activations would compare
equal and the assertion would pass on genuinely divergent work.

It needs fz-f98.21's FAITHFUL `canon`. Memoize by `Ty` in the handler: ~1,424
distinct types against ~17,500 events, so the cost is per distinct type, not per
event.

## Assertions

- every non-initial evaluation names a dependency whose content/generation moved
  since that formula's own prior conclusion;
- readiness-only movement is reported separately and causes zero recalculation;
- changed facts whose stored value is equal remain zero;
- distinct formula/product identities, evaluations per identity, changed vs
  unchanged outputs, downstream wakes, blocked and rebased completions;
- repeated runs produce identical causal work multisets;
- `unsanctioned_work_starts == 0` and `root_scans == 0` stay green.

Work counts, never wall-clock.

## Baseline to expect (measured at HEAD, 00420_enum_take_drop_split, release)

    17,574 public events; 2,593 job spans; 1,382 AnalyzeActivation
    work starts: ignition 2, changed_revision_wake 1433,
                 standing_root_frontier 3, activation_frontier 282,
                 blocked_waiter_expansion 873
    demand cones: 8 settlements -- members 1, 1, 197x4, 237x2,
                  external_members 0 throughout, 6,544 derivations
    telemetry on vs off wall time: indistinguishable

## Docs

Update `.agent/docs/telemetry.md` and `performance-instrumentation.md` with the
causal fields and machine-independent assertions. DELETE the guidance telling
investigators to infer identity or causality from counts.
title: Acceptance: causal work counts on the three target fixtures, and cross-run equality
